Honey BBQ Chicken Mac & Cheese

Creamy light-cheddar macaroni topped with sticky honey BBQ chicken. A satisfying, meal-prep-friendly bowl with nearly 60 grams of protein per serving.

Prep
Not listed
Cook
Not listed
Total
30 min
Difficulty
Not listed
Ingredients
13

Ingredients

  • 700 g boneless, skinless chicken breast, cut into bite-size pieces
  • 1 tsp salt
  • 1 tsp onion powder
  • 1 tsp smoked paprika
  • 1 tsp garlic powder
  • 1 tsp olive oil
  • 25 g honey
  • 85 g sugar-free or reduced-sugar BBQ sauce
  • 320 g dry macaroni
  • 340 ml fat-free evaporated milk (or low-fat milk)
  • 80 g light cream cheese
  • 1½ tsp chicken stock powder
  • 100 g grated light cheddar

Amounts are scaled from 4 original servings. Season to taste.

Instructions

  1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook macaroni according to the package until just tender. Before draining, save about ½ cup of pasta water.
  2. Meanwhile, toss chicken with salt, onion powder, smoked paprika and garlic powder. Heat olive oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken in a single layer, turning as needed, until browned and 165°F (74°C) in the thickest pieces.
  3. Lower the heat. Add honey and BBQ sauce to the chicken and toss until glossy and coated. Set aside.
  4. In the pasta pot, whisk evaporated milk, light cream cheese and stock powder over medium-low heat until smooth and gently steaming.
  5. Stir in the cheddar a handful at a time until melted. Add drained macaroni and toss to coat. Loosen with a splash of reserved pasta water if needed.
  6. Divide macaroni among four bowls or meal-prep containers and top with the honey BBQ chicken.

Cook times may vary when changing batch size.
